Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with an indication of hypertension. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno and filter where mesh_heading equals 'hypertension'. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
